ROUTE::expiration
Description
This iRules command returns the expiration time in second. Replacement
for the deprecated ROUTE::age command.
Syntax
ROUTE
::
expiration
<
destination
IP
address
>
ROUTE
::
expiration
<
destination
IP
address
>
<
gateway
IP
address
>
ROUTE::expiration <destination IP address>
The expiration time (in seconds) for connections to the given
destination IP address.
ROUTE::expiration <destination IP address> <gateway IP address>
The expiration time (in seconds) for connections to the given
destination IP address reached through the given gateway.
